findings.summary: Held lease restart loses provider binding; old teardown treats unknown local state as confirmed provider absence. Durable provider identity is not persisted.
findings.reproduction: Acquire via real provider, persist Held row, recreate provider with empty registry, expire lease. cloud_exec real teardown currently returns Ok on missing binding; box_ref only stores box:lease marker.
findings.acceptance: Never terminalize Held or free capacity without exact-handle provider confirmation; retain handle through ledger finish failure; restart recovery must persist/resolve authoritative provider identity and reclaim same container after confirmation.
findings.resolution: Unknown identity no longer confirms absence; new Held records have durable bindings before transition and restore exact provider domain/handle/route. Residual discovery/liveness is explicitly split into F-20260905-005; not universal recovery or live proof.

findings.summary: KV revocation receipts cannot authoritatively identify the current credential or atomically remove its mapping.
findings.reproduction: At e860910, retain a receipt for credential A of a job, then issue credential B while a different KV location still observes the cached missing job mapping. hasReceipt only lists a matching job/tenant prefix, so suspension skips B and acknowledges the event. Concurrent get-then-delete can also erase a replacement mapping. A malformed receipt value is not validated.
findings.acceptance: Credential registration, enumeration and confirmed revocation use a transactional authority keyed by exact job/tenant/pat identity. Different credentials for one job remain independent obligations; stale KV absence or old receipts cannot close a newer obligation. Cold receipt corruption and concurrent replacement tests fail closed. Pending obligations persist until confirmed; actual delivery acceptance remains a separate sprint gate. Registered live credentials remain separate from durably requested revocations; background retry must never revoke healthy active jobs. Tests exercise production authority, not only injected verdict stubs.
